'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matt Carulli LS Careful Planning (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Carulli]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Block 4)|Careful Planning (V)]]
* '''Username:''' quickdraw3457
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
